title: Todd Packer
one_paragraph_synopsis: Todd Packer returns to the office as a permanent salesman, approved by Holly, causing tension among the staff, especially Dwight who must move desks. Packer's inappropriate behavior leads to complaints and a confrontation with Michael, followed by a skeptical apology. Meanwhile, office dynamics shift with pranks planned against Packer, computer allocation conflicts involving Andy, Pam, and Erin, and playful interactions between Michael and Holly. The episode ends with Packer being sent to Florida under false pretenses and ongoing uncertainties about his impact on the office.
